title: Not My Clothes!  (¡No es mi ropa!)

segments.t: Dos minutos después de subir, el zumbador de la habitación cuatro suena en el mostrador: no dos veces, sino cuatro seguidas. Hannah sube corriendo y encuentra a Evelyn y a Graham mirando la maleta abierta. Escucha primero.
Miss Evelyn, is everything all right? You rang the bell!
Look inside this suitcase, Hannah! This is not my bag!
Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!
The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!
Two pairs of big brown men's shoes and gray sweaters.
And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!
I certainly do not wear size eleven shoes!
No wonder it was so heavy. Wood and leather!
Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!
Please sit down, ma'am. Do not worry, we will check the tag right now.
There is a small paper card tied to the side handle.
Oh, let us bring it downstairs to the light!
Veamos despacio qué acaba de pasar línea por línea.
Miss Evelyn, is everything all right? You rang the bell!
'Señorita Evelyn, ¿está todo bien? ¡Usted tocó el timbre!'
Look inside this suitcase, Hannah! This is not my bag!
'¡Mira dentro de esta maleta, Hannah! ¡Esta no es mi maleta!'
Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!
'¡Espera, es azul oscuro, igualita a la tuya!'
The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!
'¡Por fuera es idéntica, sí! ¡Pero mira adentro!'
Two pairs of big brown men's shoes and gray sweaters.
'Dos pares de zapatos marrones grandes de hombre y suéteres grises.'
And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!
'¿Y qué es esto envuelto en papel blanco? ¡Un trencito de madera!'
I certainly do not wear size eleven shoes!
'¡Desde luego yo no uso zapatos de la talla once!'
No wonder it was so heavy. Wood and leather!
'Con razón pesaba tanto. ¡Madera y cuero!'
Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!
'¡Alguien en la estación de tren se llevó mi maleta azul por error!'
Please sit down, ma'am. Do not worry, we will check the tag right now.
'Siéntese, por favor, señora. No se preocupe, revisaremos la etiqueta ahora mismo.'
There is a small paper card tied to the side handle.
'Hay una tarjetita de papel atada al asa lateral.'
Oh, let us bring it downstairs to the light!
'¡Ay, bajémosla a donde haya buena luz!'
Volvamos a oír toda la escena a ritmo normal.
Miss Evelyn, is everything all right? You rang the bell!
Look inside this suitcase, Hannah! This is not my bag!
Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!
The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!
Two pairs of big brown men's shoes and gray sweaters.
And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!
I certainly do not wear size eleven shoes!
No wonder it was so heavy. Wood and leather!
Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!
Please sit down, ma'am. Do not worry, we will check the tag right now.
There is a small paper card tied to the side handle.
Oh, let us bring it downstairs to the light!
En vez de vestidos y partituras, la maleta azul guarda zapatos marrones grandes y un trencito de madera. La próxima vez veremos qué dice esa etiqueta.
Goodbye!
